name: Daniel Brooks
bio: Daniel looks after the numbers behind Vellumridge’s customer commitments and day-to-day spending. He helps teams resolve payment questions before they become surprises.
responsibilities: Custom customer payment terms, annual prepayment combined with promotions, and finance approval of commercial exceptions.
Subscription discounts above 20%, which require joint approval from Finance and Elena Rossi, the managing director.
Invoice discrepancies, supplier payment questions, and payroll reimbursement timing. Start routine expense claims with Sofia de Vries in Operations.
